title: The Double Ghost
author: Freya Ashgrove
blurb: Lena Coldharbour, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
